context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 21 finance billing features fully functional. Key endpoints: 1) POST /api/finance/quick-assign - individual student billing with optional payment, 2) POST /api/finance/bill-selected-students - multi-select billing with custom fee items, 3) POST /api/finance/assign-fees-bulk - entire year group billing, 4) POST /api/finance/payments - auto-allocates to oldest unpaid invoices. UI has three mode buttons in Assign Fees tab (data-testid='mode-individual', 'mode-selected', 'mode-bulk'). Student Billing tab shows student list with balance, clicking opens detail view with Record Payment button (data-testid='record-student-payment-btn').

payment_auto_allocation.behavior: Auto-allocates payment to oldest unpaid invoices (FIFO)
payment_auto_allocation.updates: Invoice status (issued->partial->paid), student balance via recalc_student_balance()
payment_auto_allocation.overpayment: Creates credit note for overpayment amount
